parsed.degree_signal: abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, AI, Engineering oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
parsed.notes:
Only the candidate qualifications under “Be our forward thinker” supply skills; no section marks these qualifications optional.
Prozessautomatisierung maps to workflow-automation, which is also independently required by “Kenntnisse in Workflow Automation”.
Alternative grouping remains partially unresolved: AI/GenAI and LLMs/Prompt Engineering/RAG are overlapping alternative sets because GenAI and LLMs map to the same skill. A single alternative_group number cannot faithfully encode both sets; those sets are left ungrouped pending review. The independent language and automation-platform sets are recorded.
REST APIs, JSON and Webhooks are alternatives, but only APIs has a taxonomy entry; no singleton group is emitted. The same limitation applies to Azure and Azure AI.
Azure AI is read literally as an unspecified Azure AI offering, not assumed to mean Azure AI Foundry. “vergleichbaren Cloud-Technologien” does not add a broad cloud criterion under the “or comparable” rule.
Chatbots and Voicebots are covered by conversational-ai rather than treated as additional distinct taxonomy skills.
Practical experience alone supplies no seniority signal. The comparable field of study does not constitute an experience alternative to the degree.
